current_evidence: No newer list was found: the council's Planning and Make an application pages do not link any validation list, a web search found nothing newer, and planning.data.gov.uk's entity 20291 lists this same 2012 document. The document is not linked from the council site, though, so whether it is still in force is unconfirmed.

issues.detail: The only list available is from April 2012. It cites saved 2006 Local Plan policies and PPS25, which have since been replaced by the Adopted Local Plan 2022-2040, and the council website no longer links it. The workbook marks it 'Captured' but does not flag that it may no longer apply.
issues.evidence: Document text: 'updated April 2012'; council site links 'Adopted Local plan 2022-2040', with no validation list link on /planning or /make-an-application/
issues.grok_comment: The list really is the April 2012 version. But the workbook does flag it: councils.csv has Outdated='Yes' for Amber Valley, and every type row carries outdated=Yes.
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. The workbook does flag the list as outdated. What remains: the council no longer links this 2012 list, so it may not be in force.

issues.detail: Grokbot did not capture several items in the source: Building for Life Assessment (residential, 50+ dwellings); Land Contamination Assessment (sites with previous or historic uses that may cause contamination); Rural Exceptions Site Statement (affordable housing of 1+ dwellings outside settlement built framework); Sustainability / Climate Change Statement (all major development); Ventilation / Extraction Statement (installation of ventilation or extraction equipment); Very Special Circumstances Case (inappropriate development in Green Belt); Other Plans (all applications for operational development).
issues.evidence: Source lists 26 information items; the workbook has 23 requirement rows, and these 7 items have no equivalent

issues.detail: Coal Mining Risk Assessment is placed under 'Change of use - prior approval', but the source excludes change of use proposals. It is also missing from Full planning, although the source names full applications.
issues.evidence: 'All full and outline (some and all matters reserved) applications, except change of use proposals' (Higher Risk Coal Area)

issues.detail: Lawful development evidence (affidavits / statutory declarations) is placed under Full planning, while the 'Lawful development cert' row says '(none)'.
issues.evidence: Item: 'Lawful Development Certificate Supporting Information - LDCs for existing use or development'

issues.detail: Tree Survey / Arboricultural Report is placed under 'Works to trees' (TPO/CA tree consent). The source item covers planning applications that affect trees or hedgerows. It is not a requirement for tree-works consent, and it is missing from Full/Householder.
issues.evidence: 'All applications where the proposals are likely to result in the loss of or potential damage to trees or hedgerows'

issues.detail: Householder, Listed building consent and Demolition in conservation area all say '(none)'. The source's Heritage Statement applies to 'All applications' affecting a heritage asset, and Tree Survey / Biodiversity also apply to any application meeting their triggers.
issues.evidence: Heritage Statement: 'All applications where the development is likely to have an impact (positive or negative) on a heritage asset or its setting'

issues.detail: Every other requirement (about 20 rows) carries the note 'INFERRED: application type not named ... placed under Full planning'. Examples: Air Quality, Noise, Lighting, Retail Impact, Viability. The source sets triggers by impact or location, so these items apply equally to outline, and some apply to householder too.
issues.evidence: Most source items read 'All applications where...'

issues.detail: 'CIL Additional Information / Form' is not a source item. The trigger is a fragment of the policy-driver column of the Viability item.
issues.evidence: Trigger excerpt: '2006 NPPF CIL Regulations Corporate Viability Policy Refer to the Planning Obligations information item above...'

issues.detail: 'Marketing / vacancy evidence (loss of use)' and 'Employment / Economic Statement' both quote the same Loss of Employment Statement text, and the Employment trigger also takes in unrelated ER10 light-pollution text. The source has separate Loss of Employment Statement (allocated employment sites, non-B1/B2/B8 uses) and Employment and Tourism Statement (countryside conversions) items, and neither is stated correctly.
issues.evidence: Both triggers begin '...Loss of Employment Statement Saved adopted local plan policy EN16 NPPF Saved Local Plan Policy ER10 - Existing and likely future light pollution...'

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are column fragments or content guidance rather than triggers. Archaeology: 'N/A 7 Where to look for further assistance...'. Drainage/SuDS: 'incorporation of sustainable drainage systems (SUDS).'. EIA: describes ES content instead of Schedule 1/2 thresholds. Flood Risk: the trigger is only table headers ('Flood Risk Assessment - Continued Policy Driver Types of application...') and omits the FZ1 >=1ha, FZ2/3 (excluding householder and non-residential extensions under 250 sqm) and culverting thresholds. Planning Obligations: omits thresholds (affordable housing 15+, open space and education 10+, healthcare 5+ dwellings).
issues.evidence: Source FRA item: Flood Zone 1 operational development of 1 ha or more; Flood Zones 2/3 all operational development except householder and non-residential extensions under 250 sqm

issues.detail: Structural Survey and Retail Impact triggers are cut off, so the conditions are lost: Structural Survey applies only to conversions outside the settlement built framework; Retail applies above 2,500 sqm gross or to extensions over 200 sqm outside centres.
issues.evidence: Retail: 'over 2,500 sq m gross ... including extensions over 200 sq m'

summary: The link works and the date is right, but it is a 2012 list built on superseded policies that the council site no longer links, and no newer list could be found. Grokbot missed 7 of 26 items, placed several under the wrong application type (coal mining under change of use, LDC evidence under Full) and kept many garbled triggers.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
